blocks.raw: # File Transfer & Transformation
blocks.text: File Transfer & Transformation

blocks.raw: Templates for transferring files between SFTP, FTP, and S3, with optional header manipulation, file joins, and format conversion.
blocks.text: Templates for transferring files between SFTP, FTP, and S3, with optional header manipulation, file joins, and format conversion.

blocks.raw: File transfer and transformation templates move, merge, reformat, or convert files between FTP, SFTP, and S3 locations. These templates do not send data to Capillary ingestion APIs. Select a template, configure the block details for your environment, and deploy the dataflow.
blocks.text: File transfer and transformation templates move, merge, reformat, or convert files between FTP, SFTP, and S3 locations. These templates do not send data to Capillary ingestion APIs. Select a template, configure the block details for your environment, and deploy the dataflow.

blocks.raw: The following templates are available for file transfer and transformation.
blocks.text: The following templates are available for file transfer and transformation.

blocks.raw: ## SFTP to SFTP with 2 files join
blocks.text: SFTP to SFTP with 2 files join

blocks.raw: Downloads two files from an SFTP server, unzips, joins them on matching fields, zips the merged output, and pushes it to an SFTP server.
blocks.text: Downloads two files from an SFTP server, unzips, joins them on matching fields, zips the merged output, and pushes it to an SFTP server.

blocks.raw: **Use case**
blocks.text: Use case

blocks.raw: A brand exports two related datasets to an SFTP location daily and needs them combined into a single file before the data is shared with a downstream system. This template joins the two files on a common field and delivers the merged output to the destination SFTP server in a single scheduled run.

This template was introduced to give brands a secure, generic way to migrate files between SFTP locations with both decryption and encryption support.

blocks.raw: ## CSV to XML conversion
blocks.text: CSV to XML conversion

blocks.raw: Converts CSV files to XML format and delivers the converted file to a destination SFTP server. Supports optional encryption of the output file.
blocks.text: Converts CSV files to XML format and delivers the converted file to a destination SFTP server. Supports optional encryption of the output file.

blocks.raw: **Use case**
blocks.text: Use case

blocks.raw: A data analyst receives data from various departments as CSV files containing fields such as product ID, product name, and price. The downstream system ingests data only in XML format. XML's hierarchical structure also makes the data easier for both humans and automated systems to interpret. Using this template, the analyst converts all CSV files to XML on a schedule, removing the need for manual conversion before delivery.
